notes.title: Patch 266
notes.notes:
New:
    - (Re)-added scenarios
        - (Re)-Added the pvp map
        - Added a test level with a mechanical test case set up
        - Added GUI Elements to indicate wether another player is needed to play when connected to a server with a pvp map running
        - Added team selection window at race selection if the map has more than on team
        - Made diplomacy settings be automatically set to attack on sight for the opposite team
    - Added a ruby console
    - Added new ruby bindings
    - Reimplemented pressureplate
    - Reimplemented the mechanical system to be more robust
    - Added GUI windows for naming units, potions and spelltomes
    - ESC now erases chat/console window first, then closes all windows if open
    - Will now deselect all items in inventory if inventory is closed
    - Playername now changes as you type, rather than on pressing enter only
Fixed:
    - Fixed rendering of dart trap not being representative of it's shooting direction
    - Fixed dart trap item context and inventory images missing
    - Diplomacy settings now get saved
    - The onload script now gets deleted after one use, to prevent it from being executed multiple times
    - Fixed certain items not deselecting in inventory properly (Gears for example)
    - Fixed crafting window not being relative size
    - Fixed unit, container, and diplomacy window being too big on 4k resolution
    - Fixed the attribute window's + and ? buttons looking wrong in higher resolutions
    - Fixed potions not showing up in inventory
    - Fixed chatting not working
    - Placing levers, etc. now indicates the face it will be placed on
    - Fixed FXAA
    - Fixed shadows
    - Fixed problem with spell level 11-13 labels being cut off
    - "replenish control"-message no longer visible for players other than the one owning that unit
    - Fixed chat alignment problems
    - Misc. stability fixes...
    - Fixed placement of mechanical objects on top of tiles being slightly too high
    - Fixed units not properly moving to pick up bigger objects
    - Skeletons now render chain mail on their bodies
    - Fixed abort at race selection not disconnecting properly
    - Fixed a crash if limited vision was turned on         
    - Fixed health bars of own units not visible when occluded vision is on
Changed:
    - The game now prevents players with the same name connecting and with display a warning if you do
    - Smaller font for some HUD elements
    - Removed "'s avatar" from unit description if applicable
    - Lowered time until tooltips display

notes.title: Patch 264
notes.notes:
Patch 264 is finally in a releasable state and I'm happy to be able to do just that. Here the patch notes:

[list][*][b]New:[/b][/*][list][*][b]New interface using CEGUI[/b][/*][*]Added playername editbox to main menu[/*][*]Moved race selection to load game/join server windows[/*][*]Can now bind functions to mouse buttons[/*][*]Added ability to write to books[/*][*]Added a server list to store your servers in[/*][*]Load save screen now show what race you are playing on what save[/*][*]Improved command line argument handling[/*][*]Made building templates always be placed where pointing, unless ALT is held which will place it next to the tile[/*][*]Added effect to floors to differentiate them from regular walls[/*][*]Fixed decaying units rendering wrong models[/*][*]Fixed wrong display of "unarmed combat" and "armor using" -skills in the skills tab[/*][*]Increased max item transfer range to 60 (up from 30)[/*][/list][/list][list][*][b]Known problems:[/b][/*][list][*]Inventory items disappear when dragging and not moving the mouse[/*][*]Inventory item graphics do not fit to the window well[/*][/list][/list]

[*]Fixed a /give bug that would cause a crash
[*]Fixed manually combining items not working
[*]Fixed a problem with ATI and sometimes NVIDIA cards having a permament black screen
[*]Added the hammer + stone => sharp stone recipe
[/list]
